answer: Each submission hangs on the voyage of a task receipt, and the shale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the delta of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
